title: Preparation Method of Upconversion Nanoparticles and Its Biological Application
content: The next-generation therapeutic devices will rely on an intelligent integrated system, inte-grating different functions into one system. These individual chemical elements will pos-sess various required chemical and physical properties, demonstrating multi-functional characteristics. Upconversion nanoparticles (UCNPs) have many unique advantages, such as high optical stability, long-lived luminescence, high resistance to photobleaching, and strong tissue penetration ability, and are widely used in the biomedical field.
